## Parent goal

Link the weekly roadmap issue or decision this supports.

## Bounded question

State one question. Avoid assigning an entire research phase.

## Why this is delegated

- [ ] Literature/evidence scouting
- [ ] Benchmark/novelty check
- [ ] Engineering component
- [ ] Independent review
- [ ] Reproducibility check

## Inputs and constraints

List known context, compute limits, exclusions, and primary repositories/sources.

## Required output

- Primary-source links or exact artifact paths
- Evidence separated from inference
- Limitations and contradictory findings
- Decisions reserved for the student
- Reproduction or verification steps where applicable

## Acceptance criteria

Define how the main session and student will know this bounded subgoal is complete.

## Student decision

Record the student's choice and reasoning after reviewing the returned evidence.
